//: Profiles are named after Tarrs's three environments — dev / staging /
live. Keep these exact names: the platform's EAS panel
(Environments -> Deployment) selects a profile by environment name,
so renaming or deleting one silently breaks that env's build button.
Do NOT run `eas build` / `eas submit` by hand from inside a Tarrs
sandbox for staging or live. The platform holds the Apple/Google
credentials server-side and runs those builds through CodeBuild; a
hand-run submit either fails on missing creds or ships an unsigned,
untracked binary. Local `eas build --profile dev` is fine.
appVersionSource=remote means EAS owns the build number. Don't also
bump ios.buildNumber / android.versionCode in app.json — you'd get
two sources of truth and rejected store uploads.
